name: Text input
looksLike: empty box where I type my name
one line field with a label above it
rectangle with a blinking cursor for typing
definition: A single-line field for entering or editing text, such as a name or email address.

notConfusedWith.difference: Records a checked choice rather than typed text.

prompts.short: Add a text input with a visible label and associated help text.
prompts.detailed: Add a single-line text input with an explicitly associated label, appropriate autocomplete, and help text linked with aria-describedby. Keep the field at least 44px high, responsive, and visibly focused. Associate validation errors and set aria-invalid only when invalid.

html: <input id="full-name" name="name" type="text" autocomplete="name" aria-describedby="name-help" style="min-height:44px; width:100%; box-sizing:border-box">
Enter your name as you would like it displayed.
vue: Enter your name as you would like it displayed.
a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; }

a11yNotes: Associate a visible label; do not rely on placeholder text
Link help and errors with aria-describedby
Use appropriate autocomplete and visible focus
